runs.failure: Sampler stopped after its first completed live observation; generic STUDY_FAILED did not preserve an actionable cause. No full six-live result is claimed.

runs.interpretation: The recorded PASS verifies all six receipt rows. Two are catch_up; this derived report explicitly leaves the original six-live goal unmet. Timings from different runs are not pooled.

boundaries.clock: Windows process.hrtime.bigint; consumer timestamp after parent reads revision-matched committed SQLite snapshot
boundaries.prep_start: First client receipt of matching raw transaction; includes detection/transport, not exact server publication
boundaries.source_http: Public shared-preview endpoint with2r/s global ingress and burst8
boundaries.database: VPS PostgreSQL reached from Windows over encrypted SSH tunnel
boundaries.resource: Parent RSS/CPU only; scanner/child aggregate peaks not measured. VPS aggregate quotas remain3CPU/8GiB.
